keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «추운 밤에 마을의 불이 꺼졌다(문제)» 와 «작은 용도 영웅이 될 수 있다(교훈)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (the village fire goes out on a cold night) and the lesson (even a little dragon can be a hero). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Drago, a little dragon, and the people in the village
The village fire goes out on a cold night, and everyone is freezing.
Drago smells pepper and sneezes, and a big fire comes out of his nose.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

a small town in the country

opts: The big dragons laugh at him.
evs: He cannot breathe fire yet, and the big dragons laugh at him.
The village fire is burning again.
why: «Then Drago smells some pepper.» 후추 냄새를 맡고 나서 «ACHOO!» 하고 재채기를 해요.
Drago smells some pepper, and then he sneezes, "ACHOO!"

qs.q: "Everyone is freezing." What does "freezing" mean here?
qs.qko: «Everyone is freezing.» 에서 «freezing» 은 무슨 뜻일까요?
evs: One cold night, the village fire goes out.
A big fire comes out of his nose!
why: «One cold night, the village fire goes out.» 추운 밤에 불까지 꺼졌어요. 그러니 «freezing» 은 «몹시 춥다» 는 뜻이에요.
It is a cold night, and the fire goes out. So "freezing" means very, very cold.

qs.q: How does Drago help the village?
opts: He sneezes fire and lights the village fire again.
He brings warm blankets to everyone.
He flies away to get the big dragons.
evs: A big fire comes out of his nose!
The village fire is burning again.
He cannot breathe fire yet, and the big dragons laugh at him.
why: 드라고의 코에서 큰 불이 나왔고(«A big fire comes out of his nose!»), 마을 불이 다시 타올라요(«The village fire is burning again.»). 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
A big fire comes out of his nose, and then the village fire is burning again. You need both sentences.

ends: Drago practices every day and can breathe fire without pepper.
드라고는 매일 연습해서 후추 없이도 불을 내뿜게 된다.
The big dragons say sorry and become Drago’s friends.
큰 용들이 사과하고 드라고의 친구가 된다.

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «내 생각 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write your own idea and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because he is smiling)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because he is smiling)
write.src: “I think <u>Drago is a hero</u> because <u>he helps the cold village</u>.”

img.cover: On a snowy night in a little village of small stone houses, a little round orange dragon with tiny wings, a cream belly and two small horns sneezes a big burst of orange fire from his nose into a round stone fire pit, while villagers in warm coats and knit hats jump up and cheer.

scenes.1: On a cold snowy night in a little village of small stone houses, villagers in warm coats and knit hats shiver around a dark, cold stone fire pit, while a little round orange dragon with tiny wings, a cream belly and two small horns sniffs a small open jar of black pepper and scrunches up his face, about to sneeze.
scenes.2: In a snowy village at night, a warm orange fire blazes in the round stone fire pit, and villagers in warm coats and knit hats smile, clap and hug a little round orange dragon with tiny wings, a cream belly and two small horns, who grins proudly.

alt.1: Drago sniffs pepper in the cold village.
alt.2: The villagers cheer for Drago by the warm fire.
